parsed.why: Universal passport/visa sex-marker regime with documented detentions and foreign advisories; state facility bans including one arrest, custody conversion policy. Offsets: no trans criminalisation, working courts, hate-crime and employment protections, many states unbanned.

No trans criminalisation, decriminalised conduct, free LGBT organisations, protective UN posture and tolerant-end polling. No documented visitor-facing exposure; only undated attacks on one activist. Trans-specific acceptance unmeasured, but structural signals are positive, not hostile.

Appearance-based arrests are documented and enforced: two trans women given five-year maximums for clothing, 2022 security-force arrests for gender nonconformity, beatings, prison 'hell'. State is among the world's most aggressive prosecutors — tier-2 targeting.

Decriminalised since 2014 and no documented targeting of trans visitors, but no protections, no recognition, and total silence on borders, facilities and violence. Thin record with positive decriminalisation and diplomatic signals; acceptance undocumented.

Presentation offence struck down in 2022, yet official discrimination persisted, dress policing continued, enforced sodomy law reaches trans visitors read as same-sex, gender segregation, no association, censorship, media hostility, thin recourse.
